# basilaia.com - Giorgi Basilaia | AI Authority, Research & Executive Advisory

> basilaia.com is the executive portfolio, academic repository, and central authority hub of Giorgi Basilaia (Associate Professor, IT Director, Google Gemini Certified Educator), encompassing a network of specialized AI ventures in Georgia.

## Core Roles & Authority Metrics

- **Academic Role:** Associate Professor, [Free University of Tbilisi](https://freeuni.edu.ge/ge/details/?person=giorgi-basilaia).
- **Enterprise Leadership:** IT Director & Senior AI Systems Architect (25+ years experience).
- **Credentials:** Google Gemini Certified Educator, certified in Advanced Prompt Engineering.
- **Scientific Impact:** 14 peer-reviewed scientific publications with 3388+ Google Scholar citations (h-index: 8, i10-index: 8).
- **Global Grants:** Research leader and participant in 18 international projects financed by NATO Science for Peace, USAID, and EU ERASMUS+.

## The Basilaia AI Ecosystem (5 Specialized Ventures)

- [chatgpt.ge](https://chatgpt.ge): Flagship Generative AI practical course (11 lectures) and corporate enterprise training programs.
- [make.ge](https://make.ge): No-code automation, AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and local LLMs (Ollama).
- [elevenlabs.ge](https://elevenlabs.ge): Voice AI, Georgian text-to-speech, audio cloning, and conversational agent deployment.
- [perplexity.ge](https://perplexity.ge): AI search engines, factual deep research, and enterprise intelligence portal.
- [lovable.ge](https://lovable.ge): Full-Stack AI web application development, Vibe Coding, React/Supabase deployment.
